text:
Alex: Heads-up: seeing a 3x spike in preemptible evictions in eu-west1 starting ~1796499940, serving error rate up and tail latency creeping. Possible batch workload ripple.
Maya: link to the dashboard?
Alex: https://dash.redwood/evictions?region=eu-west1 — top panel is eviction-rate, bottom is pod-restarts and queue depth.
Tariq: ops-bot just opened an alert too: 
ops-bot: ALERT: preemptible_eviction_rate > 2% over 5m in eu-west1 (group: gpu-pool-mixed) :warning:
Maya: Ugh. Is this localized to specific instance types? a100 vs h100?
Alex: Initial slice shows most evictions on a100-preemptible nodes, but some h100 pools also spiked. Looks correlated with large transient jobs from research tenants.
Tariq: Adding the query we used to build the composite spot-signal that seems more stable than raw eviction rate:
```
sum by (zone,instance_type) (
  increase(preemptible_evictions_total[5m])
) /
sum by (zone,instance_type) (
  increase(allocatable_gpus_total[5m])
)
```
Tariq: Combine that with a capacity-gap metric and weighted interruption-rate to reduce false positives.
Maya: We should also track interruption-induced SLO impact fast — slo-bot, what's the current chat-service 99th latency vs SLO?
slo-bot: SLO_REPORT: chat-service p99 = 420ms, SLO = 300ms, error budget burn = 18% (24h window).
Alex: We're only 3% over the eviction threshold but the SLO burn shows it's material. Propose immediate short-term mitigations: 1) enable cross-region fallback for critical routes, 2) expand ondemand pool by 10% for 30m, 3) suppress noisy alerts by switching to composite-signal with capacity-gap weighting.
Maya: For (1) we need to ensure key prefixes are safely routed — will coordinate with routing team. For (2) cost hit short-term but keeps SLAs.
Tariq: I can push a quick alert-change PR: lower sensitivity on raw_eviction_rate alert, and enable new composite_spot_unavailability alert: threshold=0.03 on weighted_signal over 5m. Also add a cooldown so we don't flap.
Alex: Can you paste the alert rule snippet?
Tariq: Sure — snippet:
```
alert: CompositeSpotUnavailability
expr: (weight(eviction_rate, 0.7) + weight(capacity_gap, 0.3)) > 0.03
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/spot-fallback-runbook
```
Maya: Runbook link looks good. Add play: 'if page between 9pm-7am, prefer cross-region fallback before scaling ondemand' to reduce cost.
Alex: Agreed. Also add a dashboard panel showing 'eviction -> request retries -> spilled-to-ondemand' chain so we can see the full impact.
ops-bot: NOTE: scaled-on-demand pool +15% for gpu-pool-critical (auto action by oncall escalation at 1796500120).
Maya: Thanks. Can someone own a short RCA-style blurb for the incident and a follow-up action list? I can draft the monitoring action items.
Tariq: I'll own the alert tuning and composite-signal rollout. Planning to test in staging today.
Alex: I'll own the short-term routing fallback change and coordinate with networking. Let's reconvene in #eng-infra in 30m if things aren't back to baseline.
Maya: TL;DR action items: Alex -> routing fallback, Tariq -> alert + composite signal + staging test, Maya -> monitoring panels + runbook update.
Alex: one more note: consider adding a 1h rolling median to eviction-rate to avoid reacting to 1-off research job spikes.
Tariq: Good call. Will include median smoothing in the staging query.
Maya: :thumbsup:
Alex: closing loop — will post final incident blurb once we confirm SLO trending down.
ops-bot: UPDATE: eviction rate trending down, current 5m = 0.6% (was 3.1%). Closing page at 1796500350.
Maya: Thanks team.
